newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Mufulira production unaffected by rockfall - ZCCM.
newsitem.headline: Mufulira production unaffected by rockfall - ZCCM.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) said on Thursday production had not been affected at its Mufulira copper mine after a rockfall on Monday.
A ZCCM official told Reuters: "Production is unlikely to be affected."
The company said earlier in a statement there had been no interruption of other mining operations.
Two miners were killed and five others injured in the rockfall which occurred at 900 metres underground. It was a result of a seismic event which happened without prior warning.
The mine produced around 52,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate in 1995-96.
